findings.title: Storage Node PutShardAck Identity Mismatch
findings.remediation: Coordinator validates ack.node_id == target.node_id and ack.shard_id == planned_shard_id before incrementing durable counts.

findings.title: Orphan Process Sweeper PID Reuse Hazard
findings.remediation: Added is_fsp_process() checking /proc/{pid}/cmdline and comm before delivering SIGKILL.

findings.title: Distinct Shard Counting vs Node Count Ambiguity
findings.remediation: Implemented DurabilityContractReport with distinct_durable_shards and failure_domain_policy_satisfied.

findings.title: Process SIGKILL Conflation with Power Loss
findings.remediation: Formalized Class A (Process), Class B (OS/VM), and Class C (Power Loss) taxonomies; Class C strictly classified as NOT EXECUTED.
